method: PubChem PUG REST /PNG?image_size=300x300 - baseline, same protocol as the existing 560-image corpus. Background is (245,245,245).
ground_truth_source: PubChem PUG REST /compound/cid/<CID>/property/SMILES(isomeric),ConnectivitySMILES,InChIKey,MolecularFormula,MolecularWeight,Title - fetched in the same session as the images, keyed by CID, so answer and picture cannot drift. Every kept compound verified: RDKit MolToInchiKey(SMILES) == PubChem InChIKey.
verification: every PNG checked for the 8-byte PNG signature, opened and fully decoded by PIL, and asserted to be exactly the requested pixel dimensions; any file failing was deleted and recorded in failures[].
